what: 2811 wording (box 48446): each level of the invite chain gets a full 5%, not one 5% split (D692; referral.service already pays this).

edits.before: When someone you invited subscribes, 5% of their first payment is shared upward through the invite chain, across up to 6 levels of who-invited-whom.
edits.after: When someone you invited makes their first subscription payment, EACH level of the invite chain above them, up to 6 levels of who-invited-whom, gets a full 5% of that first payment — 5% each, not one 5% split between the levels. On an annual plan the base is one month of it; later payments add nothing.
